# City of South Burlington municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 21; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

offices.title: City Moderator
offices.org_name: City of South Burlington City Moderator

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 13 (City of South Burlington): sec. 301: the officers provided by law for towns are elected except those the charter makes appointive; the Moderator remains elective

City of South Burlington, official results of the March 3, 2026 Annual City Election, published by the City Clerk: the city's published results never list the moderator office and no holder is published, so the post stands without a membership

offices.title: City Clerk
offices.org_name: City of South Burlington City Clerk

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 13 (City of South Burlington): sec. 301(2): the City Clerk is not among the officers the Council appoints, and remains elective
City of South Burlington, official results of the March 2024 Town Meeting Day election, published by the City Clerk: Holly B. Rees won the City Clerk election for a three-year term with 4,084 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Holly Rees as South Burlington's City Clerk

offices.title: City Treasurer
offices.org_name: City of South Burlington City Treasurer

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 13 (City of South Burlington): sec. 301(2): the City Council appoints annually a City Treasurer, 'whose office shall be no longer elective'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Martha Machar as South Burlington's City Treasurer

offices.title: City Councilor
offices.org_name: City of South Burlington City Council

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 13 (City of South Burlington): sec. 302: the City Council consists of five members elected at large

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists South Burlington's five city councilors: Tim Barritt (Chair), Andrew Chalnick (Vice Chair), Elizabeth Fitzgerald, Laurie Smith, and Beth Zigmund

City of South Burlington, official results of the March 3, 2026 Annual City Election, published by the City Clerk: Andrew Chalnick was re-elected to a three-year term (2,826 votes) and Beth Zigmund to a two-year term (1,699, over Amy Allen, 1,668)

City of South Burlington, official results of the March 3, 2026 Annual City Election, published by the City Clerk: Dennis Lutz was elected 'Water Commissioner for 3 Years' with 2,929 votes -- South Burlington's elected representative to the Champlain Water District (the post title follows the Milton precedent; the ballot's styling is recorded here)
